openaiClient.setup:
In VS Code: Chat: Manage Language Models → Add Models → Custom Endpoint. Group name: Agent Spaghetti, API key: {key}, API type: Chat Completions.
In the chatLanguageModels.json that opens, add a model: { "id": "auto", "name": "Agent Spaghetti (auto)", "url": "{url}/chat/completions", "toolCalling": true, "vision": false, "maxInputTokens": 32768, "maxOutputTokens": 4096 }, save.
For Copilot sessions (the default chat) also set "chat.agentHost.byokModels.enabled": true in settings.json and reload, or the model is not listed there.
Pick it in the chat's model picker (with the agent-spaghetti agent it is the model that hands tasks off: no Copilot credits used). Which LLM answers is chosen in Agent Spaghetti (Tools → VS Code → Model); it must support tool calling. Inline completions stay with GitHub (VS Code docs).
